name: Hazor

related_people.name: Jabin
related_people.role: a king of this city, defeated by Joshua and, later, under Deborah and Barak

description: A major Canaanite city whose king Jabin led a northern coalition against Joshua and was defeated, with Hazor itself burned (Joshua 11:1-13); a later King Jabin of Hazor oppressed Israel until Deborah and Barak defeated his general Sisera (Judges 4).
